Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

15:5858 (Part I)-IS70 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

ACCESSORIES TO MECHANICAL VENTILATION 

SYSTEMS ON BOARD SHIPS 

PART S NON-RETURN VALVES 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard (Part I ) was adopted by the Indian Standards 
Institution on 3 November 1970, after the draft finalized by the Shipbuilding 
Sectional Committee had been approved by the Mechanical Engineering 
Division Council. 

0.2 Non-return valves are provided in the mechanical ventilation systems on 
board ships when it is necessary to exclude effluvia for the safety of health 
of crew. 

0.3 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this 
standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, express- 
ing the result of a test, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. 
The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should 
be the same as that of the specified value in this standard. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard (Part I) specifies the material and the dimensions for 
non-return valves for use with mechanical ventilation systems on board 
ships. 

2. NOMENCLATURE 

2.1 The nomenclature as shown in Fig. 1 shall apply* 

3. CONSTRUCTION 

3.1 The construction of non-return valves shall be as shown in Fig. 1. 



•Rules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ).

SECTION XX 



•Internal dimensions A and B of the box shall conform to internal dimensions of air duct to which they are attached.

4,1.1 All mild steel parts of the non-return valves shall be hot dip 
galvanized according to IS : 2629-1966§. 

5. DIMENSIONS AND TOLERANCES 

5.1 The dimensions of the non-return valves shall be as shown in 
Fig. 1. 

5.2 The dimensions A and B of the box shall conform to the dimensions of 
the air duct to which they are attached. 

5.2.1 The dimensions A and B shall be specified by the purchaser. 

5.3 When the flap is made of aluminium, grooved stiffening shall be 
adopted- 

5.4 The tolerances on machined parts shall be of coarse series according 
toIS:2102-1969^f. 

6. DESIGNATION 

6.1 Non-return valves shall be designated by the title, the dimensions 
A and B together with the number of this standard. 

Example: 

Non-return valve of dimensions Ax B shall be designated as : 
Non-Return Valve AxB IS; 5858 (Part I) 



♦Specification for wrought aluminium and aluminium alloys, plate ( for general engi- 
neering purposes )( revised ). 

tSpecification for structural steel ( standard quality ) (fourth revision ). 
^Specification for structural steel ( ordinary quality ). 
§Recommended practice for hot-dip galvanizing of iron and steel. 
^Allowable deviations for dimensions without specified tolerances (first revision ). 



ISi 5858 (Part I). 1970 

7. WORKMANSHIP 

7.1 The valves shall be made in accordance with the best manufacturing 
process* 

8. TESTS 

8.1 The flap shall be tested for free fall and for proper operation.
